content.name: Statics.AI
content.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
content: Architected an AI-native full-stack platform with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, AWS Lambda, and Cloudflare, delivering scalable serverless and edge-native systems.

content.name: Doo Group
content.title: Senior FrontEnd Engineer
content: Led front-end architecture and core feature development for a PC web application using Ant Group's Umi micro-frontend framework, Tailwind CSS, and Zustand.
Engineered and optimized a WebSocket-based market data streaming solution, improving real-time performance and system stability.
Developed server-side trading system features with Node.js and Koa, using async-mutex to coordinate concurrent operations safely.

content.name: Ant Group
